#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build the image, run the smoke test and publish it.
set -euo pipefail
IFS=$'\n\t'

readonly ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
IMAGE=${IMAGE:-ghcr.io/example/agentry}
TAG="${1:-latest}"
PORT=8787
declare -a ARGS=(--rm -p "$PORT:8787")
export NODE_ENV=production DEBUG=0

log() { printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date +%H:%M:%S)" "$*" >&2; }
die() {
  log "error: $*"
  exit 1
}

usage() {
  cat <<EOF
Usage: $(basename "$0") [-t tag] [-p] [--dry-run]
  -t TAG   image tag (default: $TAG)
  -p       push after building
EOF
}

PUSH=false
DRY_RUN=0
while getopts ":t:ph" opt; do
  case "$opt" in
    t) TAG="$OPTARG" ;;
    p) PUSH=true ;;
    h)
      usage
      exit 0
      ;;
    \?) die "unknown option -$OPTARG" ;;
  esac
done
shift $((OPTIND - 1))

for arg in "$@"; do
  case $arg in
    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=1 ;;
    --*) die "unknown flag $arg" ;;
    *) ARGS+=("$arg") ;;
  esac
done

command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "docker is not installed"
[[ -f "$ROOT/docker/Dockerfile" ]] || die "no Dockerfile in $ROOT"

if [ "$DRY_RUN" -eq 1 ]; then
  log "would build $IMAGE:$TAG"
elif [[ $TAG == v* && -n "${CI:-}" ]]; then
  log "release build"
else
  log "local build"
fi

docker build \
  --build-arg "VERSION=$TAG" \
  -t "$IMAGE:$TAG" \
  -f "$ROOT/docker/Dockerfile" \
  "$ROOT"

cid=$(docker run -d "${ARGS[@]}" "$IMAGE:$TAG")
trap 'docker rm -f "$cid" >/dev/null' EXIT

for i in {1..30}; do
  if curl -fsS "http://localhost:$PORT/api/health" | grep -q '"ok":true'; then
    log "healthy after ${i}s"
    break
  fi
  sleep 1
done

count=$(docker logs "$cid" 2>&1 | wc -l)
(( count > 0 )) && log "$count log lines"
files=( $(git ls-files '*.ts' | head -n 20) )
echo "${#files[@]} files, first: ${files[0]}"
size=$(du -sh "$ROOT/apps/web/dist" | cut -f1)
echo "dist is $size" | tee -a build.log > /dev/null
name=${IMAGE##*/}
lower=${name,,}
echo "${name%.*} ${lower/agentry/wrapper}"

if $PUSH; then
  docker push "$IMAGE:$TAG" && log "pushed" || die "push failed"
fi

while read -r line; do
  [[ -z $line ]] && continue
  echo "> $line"
done < <(git log --oneline -5)

function cleanup {
  local dir=$1
  rm -rf -- "$dir"/tmp.* 2>/dev/null
  return 0
}
cleanup /tmp
exit 0
